name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Filters, details, and settings that keep the page in view.

motionProfile.reason: Sheet owns its panel edge flight, the independently owned backdrop opacity, the panel's measured block size, scoped paint and owned title/description display while Base UI keeps mounting, modality and focus.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: The panel owns one edge flight whose distance is its own rendered extent; the class rules and a direct focus settle that envelope.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: The backdrop owns one stationary opacity entrance on its own rendered host and never borrows the panel's edge flight.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A closing panel returns to its own edge and the backdrop fades only on its own opacity channel while Base UI keeps the native unmount protocol.
A Button-backed close keeps its own retained removal envelope when its membership ends instead of a second sheet exit writer.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel shell owns one clamped measured block-size transaction over its natural content while the sheet is open and not yet closing.
The built-in close is a Button and keeps that component's own measured compact box without a second size owner.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Panel, backdrop, title and description each own their declared scoped paint on their own physical region, with focus and unverified palettes immediate.
The close control is a Button and keeps that component's variant paint and focus/invalid priority instead of receiving a second writer.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A directly supplied plain Title or Description string replaces only its changed graphemes; arbitrary rich children keep their native identity.
A plain Button label inside the panel keeps Button's own changed-run owner, and the built-in close text is fixed.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric quantity in Title or Description rolls only its changed places; strings and identifiers remain text.
A numeric Button child inside the panel keeps Button's compact reel owner; the close control supplies no quantity.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: The SheetContent close control is Button; Button keeps its own safe press layer, hit target and native activation instead of a second sheet writer.
